description: Sigma Operation Registry — all valid CLI operations with pre/post conditions, gating, and outputs. Phase 3 CLI implementation must conform to every entry in this registry.

level_definitions.semantic: Mutates project artifacts or runtime state (progress.json, Sigma/ files).
level_definitions.read_only: Reads existing state only — no writes to progress.json or artifact files.
level_definitions.system: Install-level operation — affects global ~/.sigma/ or host system, not project-specific state.

role_definitions.any: Any user may invoke this operation.
role_definitions.director: Director-only. CLI enforces this by convention — Sigma has no auth layer; governance relies on role discipline.

operations.description: Initialize a Sigma project in the current directory. Creates Sigma/ folder structure (rules/, design/, build/, close/, logs/, memory/), seeds progress.json, copies doctrine files from ~/.sigma/templates/, and registers the project in ~/.sigma/projects.json. Lifecycle state set to DESIGN.

outputs.description: Bridge files at project root: CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md

operations.description: Read progress.json and display current lifecycle phase, active artifact versions and states, gate status (gate_1, gate_2, gate_3), STALE_INTENT warnings, and pending actions.

operations.description: Create a DIR-INTENT DRAFT from the template. No gate — DIR-INTENT is the first artifact in the Sigma lifecycle. Auto-names the file using the naming convention: design/DIR-INTENT-v{next_version}.md. Sets intent.active_version and active_state = DRAFT in progress.json.

AUD advisory review of the active DIR-INTENT. Named 'review' not 'audit' — Intent Core is sovereign (clarity-only, not auditable). Outputs advisory findings section written to the document file. Director retains sole lock authority. Does NOT change progress.json runtime state — INTENT remains DRAFT after review.

outputs.description: Advisory findings section appended to active DIR-INTENT document

operations.description: Lock the active DIR-INTENT. Gate: INTENT must be DRAFT. Auto-supersedes any prior LOCKED INTENT (single-active policy). Sets gate_1_open = true and transitions lifecycle_state to BUILD. Propagates STALE_INTENT: any PLAN version with intent_version_ref pointing to the now-superseded INTENT gets stale_intent = true; EXEC versions whose referenced PLAN has stale_intent = true also get stale_intent = true.

outputs.description: stale_intent = true propagated to referencing PLAN and EXEC versions

operations.description: Create a DIR-CLOSE DRAFT from the template. Gate 3 chain: (1) active INTENT is LOCKED; (2) at least one PLAN is LOCKED; (3) that PLAN's intent_version_ref points to the active LOCKED INTENT; (4) at least one EXEC is LOCKED; (5) that EXEC's plan_version_ref points to the qualifying PLAN. If the qualifying chain has stale_intent = true, CLI blocks — Director must pass --ack-stale-intent to proceed. Acknowledgment is recorded in the DIR-CLOSE DRAFT metadata. Sets lifecycle_state to CLOSE.

inputs.name: --ack-stale-intent
inputs.description: Required (and only accepted) when the qualifying INTENT→PLAN→EXEC chain has stale_intent = true. Acknowledges stale chain and records it in DIR-CLOSE DRAFT metadata.

constraints.condition: Full chain: active INTENT LOCKED → PLAN LOCKED referencing that INTENT → EXEC LOCKED referencing that PLAN
constraints.error_message: GATE 3 BLOCKED: Requires INTENT → PLAN → EXEC chain all LOCKED (same version chain)

constraints.condition: If chain has stale_intent = true, --ack-stale-intent flag must be present
constraints.error_message: GATE 3 STALE: Qualifying chain has stale intent. Add --ack-stale-intent to acknowledge.

error_messages.gate_3_blocked: GATE 3 BLOCKED: Requires INTENT → PLAN → EXEC chain all LOCKED (same version chain)
error_messages.gate_3_stale: GATE 3 STALE: Qualifying chain has stale intent. Add --ack-stale-intent to acknowledge.
